name: gizza-ai/email-syntax-validator
summary: Validate email syntax, disposable domains and role addresses

tool.description: Validate an email address with offline syntax checks, optional disposable-domain detection and optional role-based mailbox detection. Returns a human report, summary or JSON without DNS or SMTP network probes.

check_disposable.description: Flag known disposable or temporary-inbox domains using the bundled offline domain list. Default true.

check_role.description: Flag role-based local parts such as admin, info, sales, support, postmaster or abuse. Default true.

email.description: Email address to validate. Surrounding whitespace, mailto: and Name <addr> wrappers are accepted and normalized before validation.

format.description: Output format: report for a multiline explanation, summary for one line, or json for machine-readable fields. Default report.
